thread:
Laura (AE): Valora just emailed — they need SOC 2 artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation for the POC. Also asked whether Dedicated capacity is required for compliance. Need to get evidence to them by EOD tomorrow. cc @Marta (PreSales) @Anita (Security)

Marta (PreSales): Got it. They also said data residency must be EU and they may request an on‑prem connector during the POC. Do we have a short checklist to send?

security-doc-bot: Automated: Compliance checklist -> https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/evidence-checklist#poc

Anita (Security): We can provide a SOC 2 summary, control matrix export, and our standard pen-test attestation letter. Clarify: do they require an external vendor's signed report, or is our attestation letter sufficient for the sales POC? If external vendor required, we need to coordinate scope and a staging window. Who is the Valora contact?

Laura (AE): Contact is helena@valora.com. She explicitly asked for an external vendor signature on the pen-test. Marta — can you ask for target IPs and whether they'll provide a vendor contact? They also asked for a KMS separation/keyflow diagram.

Marta (PreSales): I pinged Heléna asking for: 1) staging IP ranges or CIDRs, 2) vendor point of contact, 3) whether the testing is blackbox or authenticated. I sent them a short checklist: network diagram, SOC2 PDF, pen-test letter, KMS keyflow, staging creds/IP allowlist.

Kevin (Eng): I can export the control matrix and network diagram. Where should I drop the bundle? Prefer an expiring artifact link (presigned). Example command I used for other customers: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-compliance/packs/valora-poc-2026.zip --expires-in 604800`

Laura (AE): :thumbsup: Kevin — please drop the presigned link here when ready. I'll include it in the handoff to Valora.

security-doc-bot: Automated: Created evidence bundle ticket #EB-4524. Upload location: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/eb/4524 (expires in 7 days).

Anita (Security): Two things to call out: 1) If Valora requires an on‑prem/private deployment (air‑gapped installer), that's a different delivery and pricing track — need to flag pricing impact. 2) For the pen-test letter we can provide our vendor's standard attestation template; the external vendor would need to sign it or provide their report. I'll draft the cover attestation and sync legal.

Marta (PreSales): Also they asked about SLA + Dedicated pricing for the POC: what's the incremental monthly for a small Dedicated pool (<= 8 GPUs)?

salesops-bot: Quick note: standard Dedicated minimum commitments are monthly and priced per GPU-hour; for short POCs we can offer a trial Dedicated add-on: flat $5k/mo for up to 8 GPUs (needs finance confirmation). Email finance@redwood for approval if you want to lock it in.

Laura (AE): OK I'll message Heléna with the checklist and the presigned link once Kevin uploads. I'll ask for vendor contact, IP ranges, and confirm whether they need the full external report or just a signed letter. I'll also mention the Dedicated pricing caveat. Anita — can you draft the pen-test attestation today?

Anita (Security): Yes, drafting now. Looping in Legal. ETA 17:00 PT today.

Kevin (Eng): Uploaded bundle to ticket EB-4524: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/eb/4524/valora-poc-2026.zip (expires 7 days). Contents: control_matrix.csv, soc2-summary.pdf, network-diagram.svg, kms-keyflow.pdf.

Laura (AE): Perfect — sending to Heléna now. I'll update here if they respond with vendor contact or IPs. Thanks everyone.

Marta (PreSales): Leaving a note: if Valora insists on an external 3rd‑party pen test before POC start, we should schedule asap (2–3 week lead time). Recommend asking them if an attestation + vendor signature is acceptable to accelerate the POC.

security-doc-bot: EB-4524 status: bundle uploaded by Kevin (Eng). Next step: Security to deliver signed attestation template -> Anita (Security).

Laura (AE): Noted. Will push for attestation acceptance to avoid delaying the POC. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for handoff.

Anita (Security): Updated — draft attestation sent to Legal. Will post final signed PDF here when complete.

Laura (AE): Thanks — closing loop once Heléna confirms.
